title: Mule account collecting rapid transfers from many victims
summary: One receiving account took in fourteen payments from unrelated senders within two hours. Each individual payment looked ordinary; the pattern only appeared on the receiver side.
signals: this receiver has taken in an unusual number of payments in the last 24 hours
the receiving account is almost brand new, so there is little history to judge it against
the amount is many times what this receiver normally collects
resolution: Receiver account frozen and reported. Eleven of fourteen payments recovered.
lesson: Watch the receiver, not just the sender. Velocity into one account is a mule signature that per-customer monitoring cannot see.
